# Gate arm timings

Wall time for one run of each arm on this host, measured 2026-11-12 with CPython 3.12.16 on Darwin arm64. These are single local samples, not CI guarantees: GitHub Actions uses different hardware and also pays for checkout and interpreter setup.

| Arm | Command | Wall time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `links` | `python .github/scripts/gate.py links` | 0.25 s |
| `python` | `python .github/scripts/gate.py python` | 0.21 s |
| `notebooks` | `python .github/scripts/gate.py notebooks` | 0.20 s |
| `checkpoints` | `python .github/scripts/gate.py checkpoints` | 0.14 s |
| `archive` | `python .github/scripts/gate.py archive` | 0.18 s |
| `tests` | `python .github/scripts/gate.py tests` | 0.38 s |
| `fast` | `python .github/scripts/gate.py fast` | 0.27 s |

## Interpreter-specific arms

`gnn` is measured separately because it installs third-party packages and reads the network, so its duration depends on the package cache and mirror.
With the pinned parser already installed it took 0.95 s for one conformance check, excluding the install step; the install step's duration depends on pip's cache. Refresh this page from an interpreter that has the parser installed to record it again.
